methods.VIF: For each primary unit indicator, OLS on intercept + other six indicators; VIF=1/(1-R2)
methods.condition_number: Centered/scaled primary 7-unit binary design matrix; kappa=max(singular)/min(singular)
methods.design_correlation: Pearson correlation of binary unit indicators (equal to phi)
methods.coefficient_correlation: Use native MAGMA covariance only if explicitly available; otherwise NOT_AVAILABLE_FROM_NATIVE_OUTPUT

conditional_gate.hard_rule: If any primary VIF>10 OR condition_number>100 -> SUPPLEMENT_ONLY
